scope: Isolated single-instance simulated-money scenario; virtual clients are not simultaneous in-flight requests; no production capacity, maximum TPS, real payment or long-duration reliability claim.

identities.source: Direct-DB fixture sessions verified through normal HTTP authentication

backlogScope.note: All transaction workers use the newly prepared fixture store; unrelated role-test fixtures are excluded.

loadPolicy.note: Each worker alternates one menu and one paged-search request with a pause after each. Mixed writers browse between full transactions. Real server rate limits remain enabled; HTTP latency excludes client pacing and write-budget waits, while transaction and elapsed time include them.
